parameters.content:
## Analyze your bank statement CSV and get an AI budget review with Gemini

### How it works
Everyone exports a statement, stares at 200 rows and closes the tab. Upload the CSV through the built-in n8n form with your monthly budget, and a Code node totals the spend and ranks it by merchant so no raw transaction is ever sent to the model. A Basic LLM Chain with Google Gemini then reviews the totals against the budget and returns a status, the areas driving the spend, realistic savings opportunities and a simple plan for next month. Every review is appended to Google Sheets so you build a month-over-month history, and a Switch sends a different email depending on whether you came in over, on track or under.

### Setup
1. Connect Google Gemini (PaLM) API, Google Sheets and Gmail.
2. Point the Sheets node at your spreadsheet.
3. Export a statement as CSV with Date, Description and Amount columns and submit the form.

### Customization tips
Add real category mapping, or schedule it monthly against a Drive folder.

## 1. Upload & aggregate
The built-in n8n form takes the budget and CSV. A Code node totals the spend and ranks merchants, so only aggregates go to the AI - not your raw transactions.

## 2. AI budget review (Basic LLM Chain)
Gemini judges the month against the budget and returns status, overspend areas, savings ideas and a plan. Failures email the user.

## 3. Parse & log history
Flatten the review and append it to Sheets to build a month-over-month record.

## 4. Route by status
Over budget gets the claw-back plan, on track gets a keep-going note, under budget gets ideas for the surplus.
